title: Battery EMF
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the battery's electromotive force using E = U + Ir with the first set of readings.

title: Headlight Resistance
description: Important: Correctly calculates the headlight's constant resistance from the first scenario's voltage and current.

title: Motor Current
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the current through the starter motor when both switches are closed, applying Kirchhoff's current law and Ohm's law for the closed circuit.

title: Motor Terminal Voltage
description: Important: Correctly identifies that the voltage across the motor equals the voltage across the headlight in the second scenario.

title: Motor Internal Resistance
description: Essential: Correctly sets up and solves the power balance equation for the motor (P_output = U'I_M - I_M²R_0) to find its internal resistance.

title: Sign Error in EMF
description: Pitfall: Uses E = U - Ir (wrong sign for internal voltage drop) when calculating the battery EMF.

title: Ignoring Circuit Change
description: Pitfall: Fails to recognize the headlight voltage changes when S2 is closed and incorrectly uses 12V for the second scenario.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (Volts, Amperes, Ohms, Watts) throughout all calculations.
